experience.summary: I build 3D imaging tools for endovascular surgery planning.
highlights: Automated CT sorting and DICOM conversion for ISizing.
Trained a 25-structure vascular segmentation model with a 94% global Dice score.
Built vessel measurement tools that run in about one minute per case.
Developed stent recommendations from anatomical measurements.

highlights: LangGraph agents for cost analysis, forecasts and recommendations.
Improved dialogue coherence by 23% on internal benchmarks.
Deployed on AWS Lambda, S3 and Bedrock with CI/CD.

experience.summary: Built an AI support chatbot that reduced support tickets by 50%.
highlights: Built the vector search and document retrieval pipeline.
Integrated LLaMA 2, LeoLM, GPT-4 and Mistral.
